title: Valse Sentimentale
identity: Planel's Valse Sentimentale is no. 4 of Suite Romantique, for alto saxophone and piano, Leduc AL20249.

evidence.claim: University of Oulu's opened library record identifies no. 4, Valse sentimentale, Leduc AL20249, one score (5 pages) plus part.

The Philharmonie de Paris ten-year saxophone guide describes no. 4, Valse sentimentale, as a moderate waltz at quarter note = 160, with a slower middle section and return to the opening theme; listed duration three minutes. This is a guide description, not direct score inspection.
evidence.source_name: Philharmonie de Paris, Dix ans avec le saxophone

review_focus: Inference from the guide’s description: review the documented tempo/form contrast and articulation details in the score; no notation was inspected.
collection_flag: Original piece in Planel’s six-work saxophone/piano suite. The guide uses a fifth-year label, which is retained as source terminology without conversion to a college year.
gaps: No score pages or performance inspected.
